scopeNote: Yeh 30 muntakhib foreign Presidents ki exam-reference list hai, tamam mulkon ke tamam Presidents ki list nahi. 29 naam mojooda MCQs se linked hain; George Washington pehle U.S. President ke mazeed comparison ke liye hain. Sirf saal wali muddat mein exact din ka dawa nahi. Ongoing entries 21 October 2026 ko check ki gayi hain; future changes khud-ba-khud update nahi hote.

entries.name: George Washington
entries.summary: Mazeed exam comparison: United States ke pehle President.
facts: 30 April 1789 ko New York ke Federal Hall mein pehla presidential oath liya.
Washington shehar/state ka naam dekh kar har MCQ ko is shakhs se related na samjhein.

entries.name: Thomas Jefferson
entries.summary: United States ke 3rd President; Declaration of Independence ke bunyadi musannif.
facts: 1776 ki Declaration of Independence aur 1801 mein presidency shuru hona alag waqiat hain.
1803 ki Louisiana Purchase unki presidency mein hui.

entries.name: Abraham Lincoln
entries.summary: United States ke 16th President; Civil War aur Emancipation Proclamation se yaad rakhein.
facts: 1860 mein pehli martaba presidential election jeeta; presidency 1861 mein shuru hui.
Ford's Theatre mein 1865 ka hamla in se related hai.

entries.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
entries.summary: United States ke 32nd President; Great Depression, World War II aur United Nations naam se related.
facts: United Nations naam unhon ne tajweez kiya; 1 January 1942 ki Declaration mein istemal hua.
1941 ka Atlantic Charter Roosevelt aur British PM Winston Churchill se related hai.

entries.name: Harry S. Truman
entries.summary: United States ke 33rd President; Pakistan ki 1947 ki azadi ke waqt U.S. President.
facts: Franklin D. Roosevelt ke baad April 1945 mein office sambhala.
Truman Doctrine ka saal 1947 yaad rakhein.

entries.name: Dwight D. Eisenhower
entries.summary: United States ke 34th President; WFP ki bunyad se pehle 1960 food-aid proposal diya.
facts: September 1960 mein UN ke zariye multilateral food aid ka proposal diya.
Proposal ka saal 1960 tha; World Food Programme ka qiyam 1961 mein hua.

entries.name: John F. Kennedy
entries.summary: United States ke 35th President; presidency ke liye elected hone wale sab se kam-umar shakhs.
facts: 22 November 1963 ko Dallas mein qatl hue; Lyndon B. Johnson successor thay.
Youngest elected President aur youngest person to assume office do mukhtalif sawal hain.

entries.name: Lyndon B. Johnson
entries.summary: United States ke 36th President; Kennedy ke qatl ke baad office sambhala.
facts: 22 November 1963 ki succession ko 1964 ke presidential election se alag yaad rakhein.
Kennedy → Johnson → Nixon: yeh succession order hai.

entries.name: Richard Nixon
entries.summary: United States ke 37th President; Watergate ke baad isteefa diya.
facts: 8 August 1974 ko isteefa announce kiya; 9 August ko presidency khatam hui.
1972 mein China ka dorah bhi inhi se related hai.

entries.name: Barack Obama
entries.summary: United States ke 44th President; do presidential terms.
facts: Pehla oath 20 January 2009 ko liya aur 2012 mein dobara elected hue.
44th = Obama; 45th = Trump; 46th = Biden; 47th = Trump.

entries.name: Joe Biden
entries.summary: United States ke 46th President; Trump ke do non-consecutive dauron ke darmiyan President.
facts: 2021 mein Donald Trump ke successor bane.
2025 mein Donald Trump ne dobara presidency sambhali.

entries.name: Donald Trump
entries.summary: United States ke 45th aur 47th President: do non-consecutive daur.
facts: 2017 aur 2025 dono dafa inauguration 20 January ko hui.
Numbered presidencies aur unique afrad ka count aik jaisa nahi hota; Trump aik shakhs hain.

entries.name: Nelson Mandela
entries.summary: South Africa ke pehle democratically elected President; apartheid ke khilaf jiddojuhd.
facts: 11 February 1990 ko jail se riha hue; 10 May 1994 ko presidential inauguration hui.
Sirf aik presidential term ke baad 1999 mein office chhor diya.

entries.name: Cyril Ramaphosa
entries.summary: South Africa ke President; Jacob Zuma ke baad February 2018 mein oath liya.
facts: African National Congress (ANC) se taalluq hai.
ANC ki party presidency aur South Africa ki state presidency alag ohday hain.

entries.name: Anwar el-Sadat

tenures.label: 1970 mein acting role ke baad elected President

entries.summary: Egypt ke President; Menachem Begin ke saath 1978 Nobel Peace Prize.
facts: Egypt ki presidency aur Israel ki premiership ko mix na karein: Sadat President thay, Begin Prime Minister.
6 October 1981 ko qatl hue.

entries.name: Hosni Mubarak
entries.summary: Egypt ke President; Sadat ke baad presidency sambhali.
facts: 11 February 2011 ko presidency se dastbardar hue.
President banne se pehle 1975–1981 mein Vice President thay.

entries.name: Mikhail Gorbachev
entries.summary: USSR ke President; Glasnost aur Perestroika ke hawale se important.
facts: Communist Party ki leadership March 1985 mein shuru hui, lekin President of the USSR ka ohda March 1990 mein sambhala.
25 December 1991 ko Head of State se isteefa diya; Soviet Union ko aaj ki Russian Federation ke saath mix na karein.

entries.name: Vladimir Putin
entries.summary: Russia ke President; 2008–2012 ka daur Prime Minister ka tha.
facts: 2000–2008 aur 2012 se presidency ke daur alag yaad rakhein.
Darmiyani 2008–2012 mein Dmitry Medvedev President aur Putin Prime Minister thay.

entries.name: Xi Jinping
entries.summary: China ke President; 2013 se state presidency sambhali.
facts: CPC General Secretary ka ohda 2012 mein aur state President ka ohda 2013 mein mila.
State President aur Premier alag ohday hain.

entries.name: Droupadi Murmu
entries.summary: India ki 15th President; 25 July 2022 ko oath liya.
facts: President India ki head of state hoti hain.
Prime Minister aur President ke sawal ko alag rakhein; Droupadi Murmu President hain.

entries.name: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan
entries.summary: Türkiye ke 12th President; pehle Prime Minister reh chuke hain.
facts: 2014, 2018 aur 2023 mein presidential elections jeetay.
2003–2014 ki premiership aur 2014 se presidency do mukhtalif ohday hain.

entries.name: Emmanuel Macron
entries.summary: France ke President; Fifth Republic ke 8th President.
facts: Election 7 May 2017 ko jeeta; office 14 May ko sambhala. Dono dates ko alag yaad rakhein.
En Marche movement 6 April 2016 ko shuru ki.

entries.name: Volodymyr Zelenskyy
entries.summary: Ukraine ke 6th President; pehle acting aur entertainment ke kaam se mashhoor thay.
facts: 21 April 2019 ko elected hue aur 20 May 2019 ko oath liya.
Election date aur inauguration date alag hain.

entries.name: Lee Jae Myung
entries.summary: Republic of Korea ke 21st President; 4 June 2025 se office.
facts: Republic of Korea = South Korea; isay North Korea se alag rakhein.
South Korean official numbering mein 21st President likha jata hai.

entries.name: Ho Chi Minh
entries.summary: 1945 mein qaim Democratic Republic of Vietnam ke founding President.
facts: 2 September 1945 ko independence declaration parhi.
2 September 1969 ko wafat hui; us waqt ka state name Democratic Republic of Vietnam tha.

entries.name: Robert Mugabe
entries.summary: Zimbabwe ke President; is se pehle mulk ke pehle Prime Minister thay.
facts: Prime Minister ka daur 1980–1987 tha; President ka daur 1987–2017.
November 2017 mein isteefa diya; Emmerson Mnangagwa successor bane.

entries.name: Jair Bolsonaro
entries.summary: Brazil ke former President; October 2018 ka election jeeta.
facts: Election 2018 mein hua, lekin presidency 1 January 2019 ko shuru hui.
Presidential Library ke mutabiq government period 31 December 2022 tak tha.

entries.name: Hugo Chávez

tenures.label: Presidential period; April 2002 ki mukhtasar interruption alag historical context hai

entries.summary: Venezuela ke President; 1999 mein presidency shuru hui.
facts: 1998 ka election aur 1999 mein office sambhalna alag waqiat hain.
5 March 2013 ko wafat hui.

entries.name: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman
entries.summary: Bangladesh ke founding President; Prime Minister aur President dono ohdon par rahe.
facts: 1971 mein unki ghair-maujoodgi mein Syed Nazrul Islam ne Acting President ki zimmedari nibhayi.
1972–1975 ki premiership ko 1971–1972 aur 1975 ki presidency se alag yaad rakhein.

entries.name: Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
entries.summary: Philippines ke former President; Ferdinand Marcos Jr. se mukhtalif shakhs.
facts: 1965 mein President elected hue aur 1969 mein dobara jeetay.
1986 ki People Power revolution ke baad unka daur khatam hua.
